relationships.subject: bortezomib-induced peripheral neuropathy
relationships.evidence_quote: Its normalized mean fluorescence intensity (TRPV1/PGP9.5 MFI) ( P < 0.05) and TRPV1 puncta area ( P < 0.001) were decreased in small nerve fibers of patients with BIPN, concomitantly with reduced thermal sensitivity.

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: Pain levels were negatively correlated with TRPV1/PGP9.5 MFI in the epidermis and subepidermis ( P < 0.001 r = -0.44; P < 0.001, r = -0.42)

key_findings: TRPV1 immunoreactivity on skin nerve fibers is reduced in BIPN, more so in painful BIPN.
TRPV1 mRNA in skin was unchanged, indicating synthesis is not altered.
